doesnt it already have built in power kit?

Good question, and they're different things. The B30 has its own 540 W power supply built in, plus the power cord, so it's ready to run out of the box.

The P. Kit we added is an energy cost monitor, the plug-in meter that sits between the wall and the miner and shows watts, kWh and what it's costing you. Yours is the US cable version, $69.99, free on your order.
